sentences.en: The many irregularities in your language don't really alleviate boredom.
sentences.zh: 你语言中的许多不规则用法并不能真正减轻乏味感。

sentences.en: When I have migraines, aspirin doesn't alleviate the pain for me.
sentences.zh: 我头痛时，阿司匹林不能缓解我的疼痛。

sentences.en: The healer sprayed water on the patient to alleviate her pain.
sentences.zh: 治疗师给病人喷水以缓解她的痛苦。
